**TL;DR**: Wedbush analyst Dan Ives claims American AI technology is far ahead of China's.

### Key points
- Ives reportedly called US AI tech "far superior" to China's, adding that "no one will compare from a model perspective."
- The remark is an analyst's market-and-investment take — an extension of his bullish stance on US Big Tech AI valuations.
- It is a qualitative assessment rather than a verifiable benchmark figure, so it should be read with caution.

### Why it matters
The US–China AI gap is a sensitive issue tied to chip export controls, investment flows, and open-source model competition. Because this is market commentary rather than measured data, it should be weighed against the rapid catch-up of Chinese open-source models.
